changelog: Smooth pump cursor and pumpjacks, performance work, staff withdraw permission and many fixes
notes: Pump screen cursor follows the mouse at one speed and glides; pumpjacks nod smoothly and turn like GTA's own; well screen square on, no blink
Performance: steadier frames at the pump with far fewer spikes, lighter while driving, fast plate lookups, fewer server broadcasts
No more engine power reset, so tuning and nitro scripts keep theirs
Withdraw is a permission the owner grants per staff member; NPC deliveries wait 10 minutes
Station ID with Copy on the admin card, for SetStationOwner
Many fixes: craft tank sizes, NPC sales money, delivery trucks, blown pump info, jerry cans, receipts, heist
Update: replace the folder, keep your configs, replace locales/en.json, restart; set sensitivity back to 0.5 if you lowered it
